findings.name: Duplicate Workflow loses node positions: all steps stack on one point in the copy's editor
findings.summary: In the copy, every step sits at the same canvas position: the nodes are all drawn at x=0,y=0, so the trigger and the first two actions are painted underneath the last one. The canvas shows a single \"Create Person\" node (with the tail of \"Create Company\"'s label sticking out as a stray \"y\") and connect lines that lead nowhere. After a reload the same stacked layout persists. The original Quick Lead, by contrast, has its nodes at y=0/150/300/450. The copy's steps cannot be seen or opened without manually dragging the hidden nodes out. (on /objects/workflows → opened workflow editor (copy: /object/workflow/13c458a7-abc2-4f01-b492-7ba1a183488a))
findings.expected: The duplicated workflow's editor should show all four steps laid out vertically like the original (Trigger \"Launch manually\", \"Quick Lead Form\", \"Create Company\", \"Create Person\"), each at its own position, ready to be read and edited.
findings.actual: In the copy, every step sits at the same canvas position: the nodes are all drawn at x=0,y=0, so the trigger and the first two actions are painted underneath the last one. The canvas shows a single \"Create Person\" node (with the tail of \"Create Company\"'s label sticking out as a stray \"y\") and connect lines that lead nowhere. After a reload the same stacked layout persists. The original Quick Lead, by contrast, has its nodes at y=0/150/300/450. The copy's steps cannot be seen or opened without manually dragging the hidden nodes out.
reproSteps: Sign in as tim@apple.dev and open /objects/workflows.
In the table, right-click the row "Quick Lead" and choose "Duplicate Workflow" from the context menu.
The app opens the new workflow "Quick Lead (Duplicate)" in the workflow editor (URL /object/workflow/13c458a7-abc2-4f01-b492-7ba1a183488a).
Look at the canvas: only one node ("Create Person") is visible, with a stray letter "y" at its right edge and connector lines running off above and below it.
Reload the page and look at the canvas again.

findings.expected: \"Workflow run started at\" shows the run's start date/time, and \"Executed by\" names the person (Tim Apple), like the Completed run \"#1 - Quick Lead\" does.

(on /objects/workflows)
findings.expected: The dropdown reads Descending, the sort arrow should point down, and the list should be re-sorted descending — the most recently updated record (agent11-restore-test, less than a minute ago) first, then Create company when adding a new person (10 minutes ago).

Closing the panel or reselecting the field does not flip the order either. The same happened earlier with a Name sort: switching to Descending left the rows in the ascending order.
reproSteps: Go to /objects/workflows and sign in with tim@apple.dev.

reproSteps: Go to /objects/workflows and click "+ New Workflow" (a new workflow opens in the editor, address /object/workflow/e4a60cf4-0dfa-4729-890f-cb25936af600).

Click anywhere on the canvas: the title becomes "Untitled" and a save request fires.

findings.name: Changing a form field's Type wipes the custom Label and Placeholder the user typed

The typed text is lost. (on /object/workflow/2aedbf10-cc03-4437-acbf-112d63d200fc (Form action editor))
findings.expected: The field keeps the Label and Placeholder the user typed when the Type is changed (only type-specific settings change), or at least asks before overwriting them.
findings.actual: Switching Type immediately replaces the user's Label and Placeholder with the new type's defaults without any warning: 'agent4 First Name'/'Enter first name' became 'Number'/'1000' when switching to Number, and 'agent4 pick stage' became 'Text'/'Enter your text' when switching back to Text. The typed text is lost.
reproSteps: Open Workflows > + New Workflow, name it agent4-form-test, add a Launch manually trigger, click the + under the trigger, choose Form (Human Input) in Select Action.
In the form panel click + Add Field: a Text field is added and its Input settings open.
Type a custom Label 'agent4 First Name' and Placeholder 'Enter first name' in the Input settings.

Observe the Label and Placeholder in the Input settings and the field card.
Repeat with the same field: set Label 'agent4 pick stage', then switch Type from Select back to Text.

findings.name: Job title typed in the Quick Lead form is lost — the created Person has an empty Job Title
findings.summary: The Person is created with the right first/last name, email and company link, but its Job Title field is empty ("Job Title" placeholder) — the value typed in the form is silently dropped. Reproduced on both test runs (agent5job → Person "agent5first agent5last"; agent5b-jobtitle → Person "agent5b-first agent5b-last"). (on /object/workflow/c95c78b4-48d2-56f6-8e15-36ff8572f1d8 (Quick Lead Test form) → /objects/people)
findings.expected: The Person record created by the workflow carries the Job title value typed in the Quick Lead Form, as it does the first name, last name, email and company.
findings.actual: The Person is created with the right first/last name, email and company link, but its Job Title field is empty ("Job Title" placeholder) — the value typed in the form is silently dropped. Reproduced on both test runs (agent5job → Person "agent5first agent5last"; agent5b-jobtitle → Person "agent5b-first agent5b-last").
reproSteps: Open /object/workflow/c95c78b4-48d2-56f6-8e15-36ff8572f1d8 (Quick Lead) and click Test in the toolbar.

Read the Work section of the record: Company is "agent5b-co" but Job Title is empty.

findings.expected: The context menu should stay inside the window (flipping upward when there is no room below) so every entry, including \"Duplicate Workflow\", can be read and clicked.

The remaining entries — Export Workflow, Deactivate Workflow, Test Workflow, See Runs, See Versions History, Duplicate Workflow, More actions — stay below the window (measured at y≈943 with a 720px-high window) and cannot be reached: pressing End / scrolling does not bring them into view. reproSteps: Sign in as tim@apple.dev and open /objects/workflows (the list holds enough rows to fill the window — 17-18 workflows).

Try to reach the rest of the menu (press End to scroll, scroll the page) — the lower entries, "Duplicate Workflow" among them, never become visible.

findings.actual: An error toast appears bottom right: \"The initial version of a workflow can not be deleted\", the console logs the same error and the DELETE request fails. Nothing is discarded: the workflow keeps its \"Draft\" badge and the \"Discard Draft\" button stays in the toolbar, so the toolbar offers an action that can never succeed on a newly created workflow.
reproSteps: Sign in as tim@apple.dev and open /objects/workflows.
Click "New Workflow": a new workflow opens in the editor with the name field active.
Type agent13-nav and press Enter, then click the "Add a Trigger" node and choose "Launch manually" in the Trigger Type panel.
Click the "Discard Draft" button in the editor toolbar.

findings.name: Clearing the schedule trigger's cron expression is saved silently — "On a schedule" trigger left with no schedule and no error
findings.summary: Clearing the field saves it immediately (the trigger update request returns 200), no validation message appears, and the 'at … UTC' description and 'Upcoming execution time (UTC)' list simply disappear. After a reload the expression is still empty (grey placeholder only), so an 'On a schedule' trigger is stored with no cron at all; the panel still says 'Cron will be triggered at UTC time'. (on /object/workflow/0cf3e241-eb48-4c94-9dde-7c1b15fd370b)
findings.expected: An empty cron expression should be refused with an error message next to the field (as an invalid pattern like 99 99 * * * is), and the previously saved schedule should stay; the trigger should never be saved with no schedule.
findings.actual: Clearing the field saves it immediately (the trigger update request returns 200), no validation message appears, and the 'at … UTC' description and 'Upcoming execution time (UTC)' list simply disappear. After a reload the expression is still empty (grey placeholder only), so an 'On a schedule' trigger is stored with no cron at all; the panel still says 'Cron will be triggered at UTC time'.
reproSteps: Open https://5500-inb17rqkl0j8zj8qvdtvb.e2b.app/objects/workflows and click '+ New Workflow' (a new editor opens).
Click the 'Trigger / Add a Trigger' node and choose 'On a schedule' in the right-hand Trigger Type panel.
Set Trigger interval to 'Cron (Custom)' and type 30 2 * * * in Expression — the panel shows 'at 02:30 UTC' and an 'Upcoming execution time (UTC)' list.
Select the whole Expression and clear it (empty field), then click the 'Expression' label to leave the field.
Reload the page and click the trigger node again to reopen the panel.

findings.name: Delay action accepts a negative number of hours and saves it with no validation
findings.summary: The Hours field accepts \"-5\", shows no error, saves it silently (a step update request fires when the field is left) and after a page reload the Delay node still holds Hours = -5, with Days/Minutes/Seconds = 0, so the delay resolves to a negative duration. (on /object/workflow/e4a60cf4-0dfa-4729-890f-cb25936af600)
findings.expected: A duration field should refuse a negative number with a visible message (or clamp it to 0) and not store a negative delay on the node.
findings.actual: The Hours field accepts \"-5\", shows no error, saves it silently (a step update request fires when the field is left) and after a page reload the Delay node still holds Hours = -5, with Days/Minutes/Seconds = 0, so the delay resolves to a negative duration.
reproSteps: Open the workflow at /object/workflow/e4a60cf4-0dfa-4729-890f-cb25936af600 (canvas: Launch manually > Create Record > Delay).
Click the "Delay" action node to open its configuration panel (Resume = "After a set amount of time", Days/Hours/Minutes/Seconds = 0).
Type "-5" into the Hours field and click on the canvas to leave the field (a step update request is sent).
Reload the page and click the Delay node again: the Hours field still shows "-5".

findings.actual: The browser goes to /verify?errorMessage=Google+apis+auth+is+not+enabled and shows a completely blank white page: no message, no navigation, no way back except the browser's Back button. reproSteps: Open any page of the Workflows area, e.g. /objects/workflows or a workflow editor page such as /object/workflow/2aedbf10-cc03-4437-acbf-112d63d200fc, signed in as tim@apple.dev.
In the banner 'Sync lost with mailbox tim@apple.dev. Please reconnect for updates:' click the 'Reconnect' button.

findings.name: "Add a Node" adds a step detached from the flow, and Activate publishes it without warning
findings.summary: The \"Delay\" node is added as an isolated node on the canvas — the only edge in the graph still joins Trigger to \"Create Record\" — and the status chip goes from Draft to Active after \"Activate\" with no warning. The workflow is now published with a step that is not reachable from the trigger, so it never runs. (on /object/workflow/179e33c9-9502-40a8-8eca-a5aaf3bb94ee)
findings.expected: The step added from the toolbar should become part of the workflow (connected to the previous step, or the user should be told to connect it), and activation should refuse or warn about a step that is not reachable from the trigger.
findings.actual: The \"Delay\" node is added as an isolated node on the canvas — the only edge in the graph still joins Trigger to \"Create Record\" — and the status chip goes from Draft to Active after \"Activate\" with no warning. The workflow is now published with a step that is not reachable from the trigger, so it never runs.
reproSteps: Sign in as tim@apple.dev, open /objects/workflows and open the workflow "agent2-name-test" (Active, trigger "Record is created" + action "Create Record").
In the editor toolbar click "Add a Node" (top right of the canvas).
In the "Select Action" side panel click "Delay" (Flow section).
Look at the canvas: the new "Action Delay" node is drawn at the bottom left with no line joining it to the previous "Create Record" node.
Click "Activate" in the toolbar, then look at the canvas again.

findings.name: \"See Runs\" on a Workflow Version shows every run of the workspace / of the whole workflow instead of that version's runs
findings.summary: The Runs list is not limited to that version. For version v3 of \"agent11-restore-test\" (/object/workflowVersion/6812e028-9df0-428c-80d1-bb9258e63624, whose workflow has no runs) it opened /objects/workflowRuns?filter[recordStore]...[0]=6812e028... with no filter chip at all and listed all 37 runs of the workspace, from other workflows (agent12-run-test, agent2-name-test, Create company...). For version v1 of \"Create company when adding a new person\" the generated URL carried both a workflow filter and a recordStore (version) filter, but only the \"Workflow: Create company when adding a new person\" chip was applied: 7 runs of the workflow were listed instead of that version's runs. (on /object/workflowVersion/6812e028-9df0-428c-80d1-bb9258e63624)
findings.expected: The Workflow Runs list opens filtered to the runs of the version whose record the button belongs to (a version with no runs shows an empty list with an empty-state message).
findings.actual: The Runs list is not limited to that version. For version v3 of \"agent11-restore-test\" (/object/workflowVersion/6812e028-9df0-428c-80d1-bb9258e63624, whose workflow has no runs) it opened /objects/workflowRuns?filter[recordStore]...[0]=6812e028... with no filter chip at all and listed all 37 runs of the workspace, from other workflows (agent12-run-test, agent2-name-test, Create company...). For version v1 of \"Create company when adding a new person\" the generated URL carried both a workflow filter and a recordStore (version) filter, but only the \"Workflow: Create company when adding a new person\" chip was applied: 7 runs of the workflow were listed instead of that version's runs.
reproSteps: Sign in as tim@apple.dev.
Open a workflow version record, e.g. /object/workflowVersion/6812e028-9df0-428c-80d1-bb9258e63624 (v3 of "agent11-restore-test", which has no runs).
Click "See Runs" in the record header.
Read the Workflow Runs list: it shows 37 runs of other workflows and no filter chip.

Repeat on /object/workflowVersion/6766a511-cf95-5255-866c-e23c1a8cc5f9 (v1 of "Create company when adding a new person", Active) and click "See Runs": only the workflow filter is applied and the list shows all 7 runs of that workflow, not the runs of this version.

findings.name: \"Duplicate Workflow\" creates nothing and shows the internal message \"Workflow version does not contain trigger\"
findings.summary: Nothing is created: the row count stays the same, and a toast at the bottom right says \"Workflow version does not contain trigger\". No confirmation dialog and no explanation of what is missing. The same happens on a workflow that has never had a trigger configured (the state every workflow created with \"Add New\" starts in). (on /objects/workflows)
findings.expected: A copy of the workflow should be created and appear in the list (named e.g. \"agent10-list-test (Duplicate)\"), or the app should say in the person's words why a draft without a trigger cannot be duplicated.
findings.actual: Nothing is created: the row count stays the same, and a toast at the bottom right says \"Workflow version does not contain trigger\". No confirmation dialog and no explanation of what is missing. The same happens on a workflow that has never had a trigger configured (the state every workflow created with \"Add New\" starts in).
reproSteps: Go to /objects/workflows and filter the list: Filter > Name > Contains > agent10-list-test, so only the workflow "agent10-list-test" (a draft created with the "Add New" row, never given a trigger) is shown.
Right-click the "agent10-list-test" row.
Choose "Duplicate Workflow" in the row context menu.
Look at the list count and at the bottom-right of the window.
